Modified by Taqvim: for Iran, only the first- and second-level divisions were kept, with their English, Persian and, where published, Pashto, Central Kurdish, Azerbaijani, Uzbek, Malay, Tajik, Nepali and Tamil names and coordinates; for the bundled Natural Earth place list, GeoNames’ alternate names were matched to each place by name and by nearest coordinate and added only where a name was found, so most places keep no GeoNames-sourced name.

Help with dates, holidays, prayer times and backups
Still need help? Send a problem report and describe what happened.
Why can the Islamic date differ by a day from another calendar?

Islamic months start when the new crescent is sighted, so countries and calendars can begin a month on different days. With the Iran method, Taqvim computes the start of each month from the crescent visibility rule. If you turn on “Official Hijri dates” in settings, the months officially announced in Iran are used for the period they cover, and other months stay computed. You can choose another method, such as Umm al-Qura, in settings.
How do I change the main or secondary calendar?
In settings, choose the main calendar and the secondary calendar. The month view and its title follow the main calendar, and each day also shows its dates in the other calendars.
Is the Nepali (Bikram Sambat) calendar available?
Not yet. It will be added when the official month tables are available. Until then, the Gregorian calendar is used instead.
Not yet. Home screen widgets are planned for a later version.
Where do the holidays and occasions come from?

Iran official holidays come from the official calendars published by the Calendar Center of the University of Tehran, and international days from the United Nations list. Each record cites the page it was taken from, and the sources are listed under Data sources on the About page.
Why are some international days missing?

An international day is added only when its Persian title is found in a United Nations or other official Persian publication. Taqvim does not translate titles itself, so a day without such a source is left out until one is found.
How do I show or hide a group of occasions?
In settings, turn each group of event sources on or off. Ancient Iranian festivals are off by default.
A holiday or date looks wrong. How do I report it?
Send a problem report from the bottom of this page, with a link to the official publication and the page that shows the correct date. Corrections are made only from official or primary sources.

Taqvim calculates them on your device from the position of the sun at your place, with the method chosen in settings. With the Tehran method, times for Iranian cities agree with the timetables of the Institute of Geophysics of the University of Tehran to within about a minute.
Prayer times say that no place is set
In location settings, search for a city, use your device location, or enter coordinates. The same place is used for prayer times, astronomy and the compass.
Why are Fajr or Isha missing in summer far from the equator?

In some places the sun does not go far enough below the horizon on summer nights, so these times cannot be found from the angle of the sun. Choose a high latitude rule in settings to get an estimated time.
Why did the athan not play, or play late?

Make sure notifications and exact alarms are allowed for Taqvim. Silent mode and Do Not Disturb are respected: the Fajr athan plays during Do Not Disturb only if you turn that on in athan settings and allow Taqvim to access Do Not Disturb. Battery saving on some devices can delay alarms.
Why do my reminders not appear?
Reminders need permission to show notifications, and exact alarms to arrive on time. The privacy dashboard shows which permissions are allowed and opens the system settings for each.
I forgot the passphrase of a backup
A protected backup can be opened only with its passphrase. Taqvim keeps no copy of it, so it cannot be recovered. Make a new backup with a passphrase you can remember.
Does Taqvim send my data anywhere?

No. Taqvim has no account and no server: your events, places and settings stay on this device. It uses the internet to refresh the calendar subscriptions you add, and the name of your device location may come from the location service of Android. A problem report is created only when you choose to send it, with event titles, places, addresses and links removed.
